summary: Runway Growth Finance Corp., a Maryland BDC trading on Nasdaq under RWAY, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Fifth Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association as trustee on October 1, 2026, covering issuance of $46,329,125 aggregate principal of 7.75% Notes due 2031 as part of a previously announced public offering. Notes mature October 1, 2031, pay quarterly interest beginning December 1, 2026, are unsecured pari passu obligations, effectively subordinated to the KeyBank Credit Facility, and callable from October 1, 2028. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch leverage and NII coverage.
